info.description: HTTP API for uploading, reading, searching and questioning Documents. Every route except the probes needs an API key.
info.title: Trelis API

post.description: Retrieves the Documents the caller can read, then asks models.chat for one answer that cites the retrieved Chunks. Sources are numbered [1]..[n] in retrieval order; each claim is cited with its source numbers in square brackets, the answer text keeps the valid markers, and citations lists each cited source once in order of first appearance. A marker outside 1..n is removed from the text and never cited; a marker inside Markdown code or a Markdown link is left untouched and never cited. When retrieval finds nothing the answer is a fixed sentence in the question's language and no chat call is made. debug adds the retrieved Chunks (exactly as POST /retrieve answers them), the trace with a final generate step, and the chat call's token usage. Malformed JSON, unknown fields, invalid values and the retrieval rules are 400; a body over 64 KiB is 413; without models.chat the route answers 503 before any retrieval, and retrieval's own 503 (models.embedding for dense, models.rerank for rerank) passes through; a model provider's rejection of a retrieval or chat call (its credentials, credit, permission or rate limit) is 502 and names the model role in its message, and any other model failure is a generic 500.
post.summary: Answer a question from readable Documents

parameters.description: The query, how many Chunks to retrieve, which Retrieval Techniques to run and whether to return the debug object
parameters.name: request

500.description: Internal server error; a failed API key check answers the router's error body instead

get.description: Probes Postgres, object storage, Neo4j and Temporal concurrently. Answers 200 when all are up, 503 when any is down.

post.description: Runs every candidate Retrieval Technique named in retrieval_config (dense and/or bm25) over the Documents the caller can read. One technique answers in its own order with its own score; several run concurrently over max(top_k, 50) candidates each and are fused with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, score = the sum of 1/(rrf_k + rank) over the lists that carry the Chunk, then cut to top_k with equal fused scores ordered by chunk_id. rrf_k defaults to 60 and must be between 1 and 1000; it has no effect with one technique. Naming rerank adds a second stage: the candidate pool (the single list or the fused list, cut to rerank_candidates) is scored once by the rerank model, ordered by that score with ties by chunk_id; rerank cannot run alone. rerank_candidates defaults to 50, must be between 1 and 100 and at least top_k, and has no effect without rerank. Naming parent_child adds a final stage: each matched Chunk is replaced by its Parent Chunk, several matched Chunks of one Parent Chunk collapse into the position of the best-ranked matched Chunk, and a Chunk with no Parent Chunk stands alone; chunk_id, document_id, seq, score, scores and ranks stay the best-ranked matched Chunk's, content and context_header become the Parent Chunk's, and parent_chunk_id names it (absent for a standalone Chunk). Without rerank parent_child searches max(top_k, 50) deep; with rerank the pool stays rerank_candidates and the cut to top_k happens after the collapse. Every result carries the score and 1-based rank of each technique whose list carried it, plus the rerank score and rank when it ran. A bm25 request needs no embedding model. A caller who can read nothing gets 200 with an empty results list. Malformed JSON, unknown fields, invalid values, an unknown or duplicate technique, a config whose only techniques are stages (rerank, parent_child), an out-of-range rrf_k or rerank_candidates are 400; a body over 64 KiB is 413; without models.embedding, a dense request is 503, and without models.rerank a request naming rerank is 503. A model provider's rejection of the call (its credentials, credit, permission or rate limit) is 502 and names the model role in its message; any other model failure is a generic 500.

parameters.description: The query, how many Chunks to return, which Retrieval Techniques to run (dense, bm25, rerank, parent_child), the RRF constant and the rerank candidate pool
parameters.name: request

400.description: Body that is not one JSON object, an unknown field or wrong value type, a blank or too-long query, an out-of-range top_k or an invalid retrieval_config (an unknown or duplicate technique, only stage techniques such as rerank or parent_child, an rrf_k outside 1..1000, or a rerank_candidates outside 1..100 or below top_k)

500.description: Internal server error; a failed API key check answers the router's error body instead

502.description: A model provider rejected the call because of its credentials, credit, permission or rate limit (an embedding or rerank status 401, 402, 403 or 429); the message names the model role, never the provider's body

503.description: models.embedding is not configured so dense cannot run, or models.rerank is not configured so rerank cannot run (bm25 alone still works)

usage.description: Usage is the chat call's token accounting; zeros when no call was made.

debug.description:
Debug asks the answer to carry the retrieved Chunks, the trace and the
chat call's token usage; false leaves the debug object out entirely.

query.description: Query is the question to find Chunks for.

retrieval_config.description:
RetrievalConfig is the combination of techniques to run; nil means
dense alone.

top_k.description:
TopK is how many Chunks to return; nil means the default. An explicit
0 is invalid, so a client that sends it learns it is out of range
instead of silently getting the default.

citations.description: Citations is never null: an answer with no source cites nothing.

debug.description:
Debug is present only when the request set debug; nil leaves the key
out.

content.description: Content is the source text of the Chunk

context_header.description:
ContextHeader is context that is not in the source at the offsets,
such as a heading breadcrumb or a repeated table header

end_offset.description: EndOffset is the rune just past the last one in Content

seq.description: Seq orders the Chunks of one Document, starting at 0

start_offset.description: StartOffset is the first rune of the Document's Markdown in Content

chunk_id.description: ChunkID is the retrieved Chunk the marker stands for.

document_id.description: DocumentID is the Document that Chunk belongs to.

marker.description: Marker is the source number the answer text cites, e.g. 2 for [2].

access_list.description:
AccessList is filled in only for the owner, so other readers do not
learn who else can read the Document.

file_hash.description: File hash of the Document: hex SHA-256 of its content

file_size.description: File size of the Document in bytes

file_type.description: File type of the Document: its lower-case extension

parse_error.description:
ParseError is why the last parse failed; empty unless ParseStatus is
failed. It names no file name or Document text.

title.description: Title of the Document; the file name at upload

updated_at.description: Last updated time of the Document

chunk_id.description: ChunkID is the result's chunk_id, the best-ranked matched Chunk.

matched_chunk_ids.description:
MatchedChunkIDs is every matched Chunk that collapsed into the result,
in rank order; the first is ChunkID.

parent_chunk_id.description:
ParentChunkID is the Parent Chunk that supplied the content; nil when
the result is a Chunk with no Parent Chunk.

rerank_candidates.description:
RerankCandidates is how many Chunks the first stage hands to the
reranker; nil means the default. It is accepted and ignored when the
list does not name the rerank technique.

rrf_k.description:
RRFK is the Reciprocal Rank Fusion constant k; nil means the default.
It only affects a request that runs more than one technique, so it is
accepted and ignored for a single one.

techniques.description:
Techniques is the set of Retrieval Techniques to run, without
duplicates. More than one candidate technique makes the request a
fusion: each runs over the readable Documents and their lists are
combined with Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Rerank reorders whatever the
candidate techniques found; parent_child then replaces the ordered
Chunks with their Parent Chunks.

query.description: Query is the question to find Chunks for.

retrieval_config.description:
RetrievalConfig is the combination of techniques to run; nil means
dense alone.

top_k.description:
TopK is how many Chunks to return; nil means the default. An explicit
0 is invalid, so a client that sends it learns it is out of range
instead of silently getting the default.

chunk_id.description:
ChunkID, DocumentID and Seq are the best-ranked matched Chunk's, so a
citation or GET /chunks/{id} still reaches a real Chunk.

content.description:
Content and ContextHeader are the Parent Chunk's when the request
expanded to parents, else the Chunk's own.

parent_chunk_id.description:
ParentChunkID is the Parent Chunk the content came from; it is absent
when the Chunk stands alone.

candidates.description:
Candidates is how many Chunks the step returned: the search step's own
matches, the distinct Chunks a fuse step combined, the pool size sent
to the reranker, or the results the expand_parents step produced before
the cut. It is a pointer so a step with no candidate count leaves the
field out.

duration_ms.description: DurationMS is how long the step took, in milliseconds.

expanded.description:
Expanded says which Chunks collapsed into which result, one entry per
returned result in result order, on the expand_parents step. It is a
pointer so an expand step with no results still answers expanded: []
while every other step leaves the field out.

model.description: Model is the embedding or rerank model, on the step that called one.

step.description: Step names what ran, e.g. TraceStepEmbedQuery.

technique.description:
Technique is the Retrieval Technique the step belongs to, or
RetrievalTechniqueRRF on the fuse step.

bearerAuth.description: Paste "Bearer <key>", with a key from `trelis admin key create <principal>` (`go run ./cmd/server admin key create <principal>` in dev).
bearerAuth.name: Authorization
